author: CBR
description:
Yahya Abdul-Mateen II shares why he stopped working for a period, how burnout forced him to protect himself, and the rule he set for his career: he won’t take a job unless it’s an “absolute yes.” 

He also explains why Hollywood’s goalpost always moves and why chasing the next level can humble you fast.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 15 Part 2.
